fundamental_truths: The sea holds power that cannot be controlled, only navigated
Trust is the most valuable currency among pirates
The Crimson Depths contain an ancient power waiting to be awakened
Every island has secrets that predate current civilization
Loyalty to your crew means more than gold or glory
The old maps tell truths that most believe to be myths
Some treasures are worth more than their weight in gold
The rival pirate lords control the major trade routes
Magic flows through the veins of the oldest sea captains
The horizon always promises something new for those brave enough to seek it

worldbuilding.setting: A vast archipelago spanning thousands of islands, ruled by rival pirate lords and protected by treacherous currents

magic_system.sea_magic: Ancient magic tied to the ocean's currents and tides
magic_system.navigation_magic: Magic that reveals hidden routes and safe passages
magic_system.curse_magic: Dark spells placed on ships and treasures by desperate souls
magic_system.tempest_calling: Rare ability to influence storms and weather patterns

political_system.pirate_lords: Five major captains who control different regions of the archipelago
political_system.merchant_guild: Wealthy traders who control legitimate sea routes
political_system.navy_fleet: Government forces trying to eliminate piracy
political_system.independent_crews: Smaller pirate groups seeking freedom from larger factions

major_locations.port_of_crimson_tides: The largest pirate haven, built inside an ancient volcano
major_locations.skull_island: Traditional meeting ground for pirate councils
major_locations.treasure_reef: Graveyard of a thousand ships hiding countless treasures
major_locations.ghost_straits: A mysterious passage that appears only during certain moon phases
major_locations.emerald_jungle_islands: Uncharted islands rumored to contain ancient ruins
major_locations.iron_chain_fortress: An impregnable naval base of the government fleet
major_locations.the_shallows: Dangerous waters where many ships have been wrecked
major_locations.merchant_harbor: The largest legitimate trading port in the known world
major_locations.storm_eye_sanctuary: A safe harbor hidden within permanent storm systems
major_locations.lost_city_ruins: Submerged remains of a pre-pirate civilization
